text:
Maya: FYI onboarding sampleapp is stuck retrying on a token error. Putting notes here so SDK + DX can align.
Jin: Which SDK/version?
Maya: JS SDK v0.10.1. Payload from network: ```json
{
  "message": "internal server error",
  "code": 500
}
```
Maya: No type or retry hint, so UI treats it as transient and retries forever.
Rob: We should add an explicit error_type enum (auth, validation, rate_limit, transient, permission) plus retryable bool and optional retry_after_ms. SDK should expose typed exceptions (AuthError, ValidationError, RateLimitError, TransientError).
Leah: Also include meta for debug (raw_id) but keep user-facing copy friendly: e.g., "Session ended — please sign in again".
Jin: Status code mapping proposal: 401/403 -> auth (retryable=false), 429 -> rate_limit (retryable=true, include retry_after_ms), 422 -> validation (invalid_fields meta), 5xx -> transient (retryable=true, capped attempts).
Maya: Auth errors should include refreshable flag and optional refresh_endpoint so clients decide silent refresh vs interactive login. In my case refresh failed and refreshable=false should have prevented retries.
Rob: SDK shape example for JS: ```js
class RedwoodError extends Error { constructor({errorType, code, message, meta}) { super(message); this.errorType = errorType; this.code = code; this.meta = meta; } }
// helpers: isAuth(), isRetryable(), retryAfter()
```
Jin: Rollout idea: opt-in flag structuredErrorResponses=false by default, flip after tests. Add e2e that simulates 401+refresh-fail to ensure UI shows login modal and stops retrying.
Leah: Docs: mapping table + snippet copy. Also add telemetry tag error_surface:onboarding so we can track retries vs login prompts.
sdk-bot: ci/status — structured-errors branch tests passed (8/8) :tada:
Maya: Action items: 1) SDK (Jin/Rob) implement typed errors + helpers + feature flag (ETA 6 biz days), 2) Sampleapp (Maya) patch UI + tests (ETA 2 biz days), 3) Docs (Leah) write mapping + text examples (ETA 4 biz days).
Jin: One more question: treat 502/503/504 as transient (retryable) with logging of attempt counts? I vote yes.
Rob: Agreed, limit attempts and surface meta.attempts in logs.
Maya: Thanks team — I'll push a staging patch and report metrics in 72h. :thumbsup:
